research_target: A recurrent picture state that carries event history through the frozen VLM image interface.
diagnostic_question: After source anchoring repairs gradient scale, does raw micro-segment aggregation still prevent hard8 learning through norm dominance and cancellation?

single_changed_variable.name: micro_segment_gradient_aggregation
single_changed_variable.common_execution: Both arms compute the eight per-segment gradients independently in the same deterministic order.
single_changed_variable.magnitude_control: The applied unit-balanced gradient must match the raw-mean global L2 norm before the unchanged clip=10 operation.
fail_closed: every micro-gradient is finite and nonzero
the aggregate is finite and nonzero
relative norm-match error is at most 1e-5
the unit-balanced intervention changes direction on at least one optimizer step

fixed_contract.learning_rate_schedule: R5 640-step schedule prefix: 16-step 1e-5 to 3e-5 warmup then cosine toward 1e-5

paired_diagnostics: per-step raw versus applied gradient cosine and norm-match error
per-step micro-gradient norm ratio and negative pairwise cosine fraction
hard8 train endpoint versus arm-specific M0
fixed formal-select-32 endpoint versus arm-specific M0
fixed mechanism-select-32 endpoint versus arm-specific M0
normal/reset difference-in-differences from M0 to endpoint

interpretation_rules.unit_pass_raw_fail: Support norm-dominance as a primary local failure cause; advance source-anchor plus unit balancing to the unchanged fixed full-data pilot.
interpretation_rules.both_fail: Reject unit balancing as sufficient; next test deterministic conflict projection on the identical hard8 before changing rank, data volume, Reader, or loss.
interpretation_rules.both_pass: Aggregation is not necessary for local learnability; fixed-dev evidence and simplicity select the advancing law.
interpretation_rules.raw_pass_unit_fail: Reject unit balancing and retain raw aggregation.

formal_success_still_requires: normal better than reset and state swaps
endpoint improvement over its own M0 with paired uncertainty
